title: 2026 Audi Q2
description: Premium compact SUV style meets smart everyday usability in this 2026 Audi Q2 35TFSI Black Edition. Finished in Daytona Grey, this Audi Q2 35TFSI Black Edition delivers the premium feel and sharp crossover presence many buyers want in a compact SUV. Its 1.4-litre petrol engine pairs with Audi’s 7-speed S tronic automatic transmission for smooth, effortless driving, while the 110 kW output and 250 Nm of torque give it confident performance for daily commuting and open-road travel alike. With five doors, five seats and a practical load area of 405 litres, the Q2 is well suited to modern family life and busy urban routines. This demo model has an odometer reading of 3 987 km, and combines comfort, technology and efficiency with average fuel consumption of 6.1 litres/100 km. If you are looking for a premium SUV that feels easy to live with yet still stands out, this Q2 makes a strong impression. Key Features: • Matrix LED headlights • Panoramic roof • Rear-view camera • Front and rear park distance control • Keyless access and start • Heated front seats • Digital instruments
